note: On Iron Mountain Road (US-16A) between Keystone and Custer State Park, south of the Iron Mountain tunnels. The operator warns that GPS sends RVs through tunnels as low as 12'2" and posts routes in via Keystone and Playhouse Road or from Custer State Park that reach the campground before them. No TVs and limited cell service by design. Level, grassy RV sites back onto national forest or, for sites 54-62, onto Spokane Creek; tent sites, cabins, a pool, mini-golf, a café and an Iron Mountain Road visitor center share the property. --Claude
